notes.title: Secret Project.... More Testers Needed!
notes.content:
Hello Crash Drivers!

We appreciate you for the countless hours that you've spent driving around in Crash Drive 2 and we would like to hear YOUR opinion about the future of the Crash Drive franchise.
We have set up a special development environment to test something very secret...! Currently, this is only available on Steam for the Windows platform.

The requirements to participate in the development environment are:
- A windows computer
- A Steam account with a copy of Crash Drive 2
- A Discord account

If you're interested sign up by clicking on the following link: TEST NO LONGER OPEN

While you are allowed and encouraged to get friends to join in too, please do not share information about this event publicly.

Race you later!

notes.title: CD2 Christmas update
notes.content:
Today we've released a small Steam-only update that fills the snow level with Christmas themed props. Go check it out while you can: The Christmas event is live starting today, 20 December until 31 December. This will be a recurring event from now on.

Happy holidays!

notes.title: CD2 engine update & cloud save!
notes.content:
http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/404557344539422846/CDA59164C894DBEB3EDF1806078BFD69C69DE7D3/

We've updated CD2 to improve hardware support and also making it easier for us to keep maintaining the game.

Changes:

 Save data is now synced to Steam Cloud!
 Data is now saved&loaded per steam account and won't mix after switching accounts
 Updated Unity from 4.6 to Unity 5.5 for better hardware compatability
 Shady dealer car now aligns to terrain and drives less choppy
 Added an easter egg to the tropical level
 Now showing settings screen pre-game
 Fixed various errors that were logged


Do let us know if this update somehow introduced any new issues.

Join our Discord channel to talk about CD2 and other M2H games: https://discordapp.com/invite/WDR8Utd

notes.title: Minor update v7: Tank battles fixes
notes.content:
https://i.gyazo.com/340fcd72abb4fd97e52dfbc00a44de0f.gif

We just launched a minor update. This update fixes the bug where player are no longer able to play tank battles because the Tank mode has the Schoolbus selected instead of a normal tank. The game apparently completely blows up because of this.

Last but not least we also updated the game to Unity 4.7.0f1 which brings various small fixes

notes.title: Engine update
notes.content:
We've updated the game to the latest Unity engine 4.X version (4.6.8). This will address various platform specific issues (input, controller detection etc.)

For those who have controller issues:
You can customize your controller setup in the input window pre-game.
 To open this window:
 On Mac: hold the options key while starting the game to open the setting dialog
 On Windows: hold the options key while starting the game to open the setting dialog
On Linux: Add to the games launch options: -show-screen-selector
